checks.method: All slide IDs unique; actual slide count equals records; all six mandatory fields; exactly one role and boolean illustration decision.
checks.failure_handling: Missing record or silent default

checks.method: Compare scientific IR, literal numbers/units/conditions/negations, source bindings and rendered realization; no new unsourced statements.
checks.failure_handling: Changed or unverifiable scientific content

checks.method: Compare approved nodes, grouping, direction, endpoints, ordering and equal weights to native objects and render.
checks.failure_handling: Ambiguous graph requires author decision; record retained limits

checks.method: Check exact source/hash, asset provenance, scope/project/deck/slide/role, allowed transform, revocation and reviewed composite preview.
checks.failure_handling: CANDIDATE, wrong scope or unknown evidence blocks insertion

checks.method: AI flags immutable; no generated clinical traces/images/charts/evidence; source figure precedence.
checks.failure_handling: Any attempted replacement or unsafe resemblance

checks.method: Every exception has rejected alternatives, reason, reason provenance and human review record.
checks.failure_handling: Retrospective reason is not an original selection receipt

checks.method: Resolve role-specific minimum and compare realized font/size; check text geometry and exceptions.
checks.failure_handling: Unknown resolved size or clipping prevents validation

checks.method: PPTX, PDF, PNG count and hashes align; contact sheet exists with all pages; inspect each slide.
checks.failure_handling: Missing/stale render or sheet

checks.method: Dominant observed macro-family share and longest adjacent run; proposed limits, per-role detail.
checks.failure_handling: Not an agreed aesthetic boundary; no optimizing by changing semantics

checks.method: Generic-card slide count / all slides; reasons and adjacency reviewed.
checks.failure_handling: Cards with authentic table/semantic structure are not generic by shape alone

checks.method: Inspect one intended focal point against actual render, title/figure competition and reading order.
checks.failure_handling: No shape-count proxy

checks.method: Compare communicative role and observed scene, including same-role variants.
checks.failure_handling: No need to use all ten roles

checks.method: Inspect title, body, units and caption hierarchy at projection scale and retained equality.
checks.failure_handling: Equal scientific concepts must not gain spurious ranks

checks.method: Review sheet for contrast, palette and spacing; use approved brief, not compulsory dark pages.
checks.failure_handling: Counted color alternation is not quality

checks.method: Decorative illustrated slides/all slides; overlay intersection and focal competition reviewed.
checks.failure_handling: Authorized useful illustrations still require composite review

checks.method: Review eligible low/medium-density conceptual pages with no illustration against recorded rationale.
checks.failure_handling: Do not force image on evidence/dense/ambiguous pages

checks.method: Inspect existing full contact sheet and representative slide renders; final owner review separate.
checks.criterion: Human signed decision on frozen hash
checks.failure_handling: No mathematical reference-grade aesthetics

checks.method: Record every applicable directive as matched/deviated/not assessed; immutable brief hash and per-slide receipt.
checks.failure_handling: Recorded coverage is not execution success

checks.method: Allowlisted minimal abstraction, local trusted approval lookup, export policy and no raw notes/data/IDs.
checks.failure_handling: Schema or keyword scan alone cannot certify deidentification

checks.method: Final scientific and visual approvals bound to exact deck/render hash and unresolved items.
checks.failure_handling: Pending approval holds acceptance without fabricating a reviewer decision
